purpose: Freeze a repaired-model development cohort after the v1 priority-mask defect exposed the original development subjects.
selection: From the former 68-subject training pool only, greedily cover up to three subjects per available task using inverse task availability; break ties by SHA-256(seed, subject), then fill by the same deterministic order. Read metadata identities only, preserve existing windows/masks, and exclude all 17 exposed v1 development subjects.
interpretation: A future development cohort for the versioned complete-priority repair. These subjects participated in v1 training, but no v2 weights or per-subject outcomes exist when this split is frozen.
